name: io.github.nagametw/mcp-server-malcolm
description: The first MCP server for Malcolm, the open-source network traffic analysis suite (Zeek + Suricata + Arkime + OpenSearch + NetBox). Structured threat-hunting access for AI agents: search and aggregate traffic, discover fields, query Suricata alerts, browse Arkime sessions, and resolve NetBox assets. Read-only by default; opt-in, audited write classes.
